answer: Cedar-ring tenure bonds make trust grow slowly. A newcomer locks $30, then adds $25 a month for six months and finishes four verified jobs a month, while three established peers check each ring. Miss a month or fail an audit and the ring breaks, forfeiting $50 and restarting the count. After six rings, $180 sits locked and 24 jobs stand on record, so the profile becomes a haven clients can trust. Forging 1,000 fakes would cost $180,000 plus 24,000 jobs, around 6,000 hours. The horizon stays far off for fakes: a cedar cannot be rushed through six months of growth in a day.
